decks.domain: Right of way, passing and turning

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Follow traffic signs and signals, but obey a police officer or.
cards.back: Follow traffic signs and signals, but obey a police officer or firefighter directing traffic even when that direction differs from the devices.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Do not drive on a road officially closed.
cards.back: Do not drive on a road officially closed for construction, an event or another authorized reason.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Right of way identifies who may make a traffic movement. Give way.
cards.back: Right of way identifies who may make a traffic movement. Give way to prevent a collision even when another person fails to respect your lawful priority.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: At a stop sign where cross traffic does not stop, first stop.
cards.back: At a stop sign where cross traffic does not stop, first stop and then yield to people or vehicles already in the intersection or close enough to make entry dangerous.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: At an uncontrolled intersection, when vehicles arrive together, the driver.
cards.back: At an uncontrolled intersection, when vehicles arrive together, the driver on the left yields to the driver on the right.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: At an all-way stop, yield to pedestrians and let vehicles proceed in.
cards.back: At an all-way stop, yield to pedestrians and let vehicles proceed in arrival order. When vehicles arrive at about the same time, yield to the vehicle on your right.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Take your turn at a stop-controlled intersection when safe, without needless delay.
cards.back: Take your turn at a stop-controlled intersection when safe, without needless delay. If another driver takes it, allow that vehicle to proceed rather than insist on priority.

decks.domain: Right of way, passing and turning

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Turning left at a junction, or entering a driveway.
cards.back: Turning left at a junction, or entering a driveway or alley on the left, requires yielding to opposing traffic.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: At a yield sign, reduce speed enough for safety and be ready.
cards.back: At a yield sign, reduce speed enough for safety and be ready to stop. Stop when necessary and continue only with a safe opening.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: When merging without a stop, adjust speed and position to join safely.
cards.back: When merging without a stop, adjust speed and position to join safely. When another road merges into yours, move away if safely possible; otherwise adjust your speed and position to let the traffic join.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: A green signal does not authorize entering an occupied.
cards.back: A green signal does not authorize entering an occupied or unsafe intersection. Wait until the traffic conflict has cleared.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Before entering or crossing a highway from a private road or alley.
cards.back: Before entering or crossing a highway from a private road or alley, stop and yield to vehicles and pedestrians already using the road or sidewalk being crossed.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: For an emergency vehicle using a siren and emergency lights, slow, move.
cards.back: For an emergency vehicle using a siren and emergency lights, slow, move safely to the shoulder or as far right as practicable, and stop. Avoid endangering others or blocking an intersection or the emergency vehicle's turn.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: In a construction area, yield.
cards.back: In a construction area, yield to highway-maintenance workers and their vehicles.

decks.domain: Right of way, passing and turning

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: A right turn at a red traffic light is.
cards.back: A right turn at a red traffic light is permitted unless the intersection has a sign prohibiting that turn.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: A permitted turn on red requires a complete stop first, yielding to.
cards.back: A permitted turn on red requires a complete stop first, yielding to traffic and pedestrians, and a determination that the turn can be completed safely.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: A left turn on red is permitted from the left lane of.
cards.back: A left turn on red is permitted from the left lane of a one-way street to another one-way street carrying traffic to the left, unless a posted sign prohibits it. Stop, yield and confirm a safe opening first.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Flashing yellow school-bus lights warn approaching drivers to slow and prepare.
cards.back: Flashing yellow school-bus lights warn approaching drivers to slow and prepare to stop, watching particularly for children beside or crossing the road.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: When a school bus displays red flashing lights and its extended stop.
cards.back: When a school bus displays red flashing lights and its extended stop arms while loading or unloading, passing it is prohibited. Opposite-direction traffic across a dividing median need not stop, but must watch for children.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: For the roadside emergency, sanitation or utility vehicles covered by the Move.
cards.back: For the roadside emergency, sanitation or utility vehicles covered by the Move Over law, change to the next lane when safe. If a safe lane change is unavailable, drive below the posted limit and be ready to stop.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: The described Move Over protection includes authorized emergency vehicles displaying flashing warning.
cards.back: The described Move Over protection includes authorized emergency vehicles displaying flashing warning lights, and active sanitation or utility workers using cones or flashing-light vehicles.

decks.domain: Right of way, passing and turning

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: On a two-lane road, begin passing only in a marked passing zone.
cards.back: On a two-lane road, begin passing only in a marked passing zone and only with enough space to return fully to the right before the zone ends or an intersection is reached.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: A two-lane passing maneuver must be completed before an.
cards.back: A two-lane passing maneuver must be completed before an approaching vehicle is within two hundred feet of your vehicle.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Before pulling out to pass, check rear and side mirrors and look.
cards.back: Before pulling out to pass, check rear and side mirrors and look over the shoulder for the blind spot; make sure another vehicle is not already passing you.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Signal left before passing. Return right only when safely clear and able.
cards.back: Signal left before passing. Return right only when safely clear and able to see the passed vehicle in the rearview mirror; signal right for the return and cancel the signal afterward.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Do not pass on a two-lane road where the line on your.
cards.back: Do not pass on a two-lane road where the line on your side is solid yellow, where double yellow lines prohibit the move, or where a no-passing sign is posted.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: On a two-lane road, passing is prohibited within one.
cards.back: On a two-lane road, passing is prohibited within one hundred feet of a railroad crossing, bridge, viaduct or tunnel.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Do not pass where an oncoming vehicle makes the move unsafe, where.
cards.back: Do not pass where an oncoming vehicle makes the move unsafe, where a hill or curve hides approaching traffic, on the shoulder, or past a school bus stopped for passengers.

decks.domain: Right of way, passing and turning

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Driving left of the centerline to get around an.
cards.back: Driving left of the centerline to get around an obstruction is allowed only after yielding to oncoming traffic.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: On a multilane two-way highway, do not cross left of the centerline.
cards.back: On a multilane two-way highway, do not cross left of the centerline except when signs or signals authorize it or when turning left into a private road, alley or driveway.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Passing on the right is allowed beside a vehicle turning or preparing.
cards.back: Passing on the right is allowed beside a vehicle turning or preparing to turn left when the pavement has room for both vehicles, or on a highway with at least two same-direction lanes.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: When being passed, do not accelerate until the passing vehicle has completely.
cards.back: When being passed, do not accelerate until the passing vehicle has completely cleared you. A slight speed reduction can help it finish; remain alert for unsafe actions.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Do not pass a vehicle stopped for a pedestrian.
cards.back: Do not pass a vehicle stopped for a pedestrian at a marked crosswalk or an unmarked intersection crosswalk.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: When stopping for a person in a crosswalk, leave enough.
cards.back: When stopping for a person in a crosswalk, leave enough space for other approaching drivers to see the entire crossing.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Approach an intersection with stopped vehicles slowly and ready to stop even.
cards.back: Approach an intersection with stopped vehicles slowly and ready to stop even if their signal permits travel; those vehicles may be screening a pedestrian from view.

decks.domain: Right of way, passing and turning

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Approach a bicycle cautiously and, when road and traffic conditions permit.
cards.back: Approach a bicycle cautiously and, when road and traffic conditions permit, change to a lane that is not adjacent to it before passing.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: When traffic conditions or law prevent changing lanes to pass a bicycle.
cards.back: When traffic conditions or law prevent changing lanes to pass a bicycle, the passing vehicle must keep at least three feet away from the bicycle throughout the maneuver.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: A motorcyclist is entitled to the entire lane. Pass.
cards.back: A motorcyclist is entitled to the entire lane. Pass in a neighboring lane rather than sharing the motorcycle's lane.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Weaving between lanes merely to outrun traffic is unlawful. Pass.
cards.back: Weaving between lanes merely to outrun traffic is unlawful. Pass slower traffic only through safe lane changes with clear signals.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Signal continuously far enough before each left or right.
cards.back: Signal continuously far enough before each left or right turn to warn other drivers; avoid abrupt last-moment turns.

decks.domain: Right of way, passing and turning

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Do not flash a turn signal to tell.
cards.back: Do not flash a turn signal to tell a following driver that it is safe to pass.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: For a right turn, give advance notice, approach in the right lane.
cards.back: For a right turn, give advance notice, approach in the right lane near the curb or road edge, and yield to bicyclists continuing straight in a bicycle lane.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Finish a right turn in the right lane. Where several.
cards.back: Finish a right turn in the right lane. Where several marked lanes turn together, finish in the corresponding receiving lane.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: For a left turn, signal early and approach from the far-left lane.
cards.back: For a left turn, signal early and approach from the far-left lane in your direction or the provided turn lane. Keep the wheels straight until the turn begins.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: Before a left turn, yield to opposing vehicles.
cards.back: Before a left turn, yield to opposing vehicles, including bicycles, and to pedestrians crossing either road.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: When signs, signals and a safe opening permit the left turn, finish.
cards.back: When signs, signals and a safe opening permit the left turn, finish in the receiving lane nearest the centerline or center lanes. With multiple turn lanes, use the corresponding receiving lane.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: After entering the intersection for a left.
cards.back: After entering the intersection for a left turn, do not switch lanes within the intersection.

cards.front: Complete the statement beginning: When turning into a road with pedestrians in its crosswalk, stop.
cards.back: When turning into a road with pedestrians in its crosswalk, stop and remain stopped until they clear the lanes you will travel through.
